name: FAN EXPO Philadelphia
blurb: FAN EXPO HQ's Philadelphia show at the Pennsylvania Convention Center, covering comics, sci-fi, horror and anime.

editions.evidence: Page JSON-LD: Event "FAN EXPO Philadelphia" 2027-05-28 -> 2027-05-30 @ Pennsylvania Convention Center; same text on page: 'MAY 28 - 30, 2027 PENNSYLVANIA CONVENTION CENTER'.

notes: Multi-city FAN EXPO HQ brand; successor to Wizard World Philadelphia. Both the celebrities and comic-creators guest pages show only a 'PAST FAN FAVE GUESTS INCLUDED' section (Orlando Bloom, David Tennant, Jim Lee, Frank Miller, etc.) with 'sign up for updates' copy, not a 2027 lineup, so guests is 'none-yet'. Cover falls back to the 'FAN EXPO Philadelphia' wordmark logo (no Philadelphia-specific key art found; hero images are generic photo-op/autograph/category stock photos shared across the network).
